name: r3-03-concurrent-commands
title: Concurrent promote / abort / W1a restore-original on one storage: 13 cycles, 0 invariant violations
subtitle: exact head f2a349be · every cycle prepares a fresh operation from the storage's CURRENT root (retire → W1a fence → capture → cp -a → prepare). D-cycles SIGSTOP the promote JVM the instant its marker temporary appears in the target (inotify), run the competing command to completion, then SIGCONT. R-cycles start abort at a fraction of the measured promote time.

name: r3-04-power-loss
title: Power loss at every flush point of prepare → promote (dm-log-writes replay)
subtitle: target ext4 on dm-log-writes (noatime, commit=60). Crash state k = log replayed through entry k onto a zero image, mounted via dm-linear with the SAME 253:214 (st_dev 64982) so the recorded identity still holds; the mount replays the ext4 journal as after a reboot. SQL + bundle restored to the snapshot of that moment (prepared / mid = promote paused at its temporary / post = after the SQL commit). Retry = plain `promote` with the shipped jar.

sections.heading: PR head (shipped jar)
lines: == log 229 entries; replayer self-check: replaying all entries reproduces the recorded device byte for byte
++ 25 crash prefixes between prepared and end: marker OLD ×24 / NEW ×1, never torn or missing
++ temporary none ×11 / complete ×14 (never empty or partial); e2fsck -fn clean 25/25
++ COMMIT POINT (last FLUSH/FUA before promote returned, entry 207): marker already NEW, no temporary
++ 10 retries at the 6 flush points × matching snapshot: all COMPLETED rev 2, marker NEW, no temporary, fence cleared
++ full stack after 3 representative cuts (old marker + complete temp · first NEW marker · commit point with SQL COMPLETED):
++   Spring with the new mapping + fresh Harness: cold load 200, write ok, pre-migration undo 200 (notes v1),
++   W1a inspect state=ready revision=2 identity=match marker=match

sections.heading: Negative control: the four FileChannel.force() calls removed from publishMigrationMarker
lines: == zero writes reach the target device between `prepared` and `promote returned` (publication stays in the page cache)
-- power cut right after the SQL commit: SQL READY rev 2 at the target, but the target marker is still the OLD one
-- retry returns the COMPLETED receipt without republishing; Turn → hosted_turn_failed, undo 409,
--   W1a inspect: state=ready revision=2 identity=match marker=mismatch   (storage stuck)
== with the mid snapshot instead (cut before the commit) the retry repairs it: COMPLETED rev 2, marker NEW

note: The shipped order (write temp → fsync → rename → fsync root → fsync parent → SQL commit) keeps the storage serviceable after a power cut at any flush point, and plain retry converges from every pre-commit state. The control shows the harness detects the failure mode those fsyncs prevent.

name: r3-05-r7-1-fence-missed
title: R7-1 reproduces end to end: a create-session queued behind retire is admitted onto the fenced storage
subtitle: exact head f2a349be · Spring RUNNING (the admission surface the fence guards) · MySQL 8.4 REPEATABLE READ. The interleaving is forced from outside the product: connection X holds the tenant's placement-guard row (FOR UPDATE); `retire` queues on it; POST /v1/agents/sessions runs its first consistent read (findWorkspaceCommand) and queues behind retire; X commits.
